Indexes:
    "lockconfiguration_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)
    "lockconfiguration_data_objid_index" btree (objid)
    "lockconfiguration_editing_session_index" btree (editingsession) WHERE editingsession <> '-1'::integer
Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON lockconfiguration_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_lockconfiguration_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON lockconfiguration_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_lockconfiguration_data()

### dleobjectderef_data

**Schema Definition:**

```sql
                                                            Table "public.dleobjectderef_data"
           Column            |          Type          | Collation | Nullable |              Default               | Storage  | Stats target | Description 
-----------------------------+------------------------+-----------+----------+------------------------------------+----------+--------------+-------------
 objid                       | uuid                   |           | not null |                                    | plain    |              | 
 blobonlyinfo                | text                   |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 checkpointobjid             | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              |

 dlesession                  | smallint               |           |          | mysessionid()                      | plain    |              | 
 domainid                    | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              |

 excludefromsync             | boolean                |           |          | false                              | plain    |              | 
 featurespreset              | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 folder                      | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 fwset                       | text                   |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 ipaddresses                 | text                   |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 name                        | text                   |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 nameuniquenessscope         | character varying(255) |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 objclass                    | character varying(255) |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 objectoverview              | text                   |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 permissionprimitivepresetid | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 readprimitiveid             | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 tabletype                   | integer                |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 tsdata                      | tsvector               |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 tsfacet                     | tsvector               |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 validname                   | boolean                |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 varfields                   | jsonb                  |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 opid                        | bigint                 |           | not null | nextval('opid_sequence'::regclass) | plain    |              | 
 fromversion                 | integer                |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 toversion                   | integer                |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 editingsession              | smallint               |           |          | '-1'::integer                      | plain    |              | 
 deleted                     | boolean                |           |          | false                              | plain    |              | 
Indexes:
    "dleobjectderef_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)
    "dleobjectderef_data_chkid_dom_idx" btree (checkpointobjid, domainid) WHERE checkpointobjid IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_cpmitable_index" btree (cpmitable)
    "dleobjectderef_data_cpmitype_index" btree (cpmitype)
    "dleobjectderef_data_dlesession_excludefromsync_objclass_index" btree (objclass, dlesession, excludefromsync) WHERE objclass IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_dlesession_index" btree (dlesession)
    "dleobjectderef_data_folder_index" btree (folder)
    "dleobjectderef_data_mixed_features_domain_idx" btree (featurespreset, domainid) WHERE featurespreset IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_name_comment_trgm_idx" gin (name gin_trgm_ops, (varfields ->> 'comments__s'::text) gin_trgm_ops, (varfields ->> 'ipaddr__s'::text) gin_trgm_ops, domainid) WHERE tsdata IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_name_index" btree (name) WHERE name IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_name_lower_index" btree (lower(name)) WHERE name IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_objclass_idx" gin ((varfields -> 'objclass'::text) jsonb_path_ops, domainid) WHERE (varfields -> 'objclass'::text) IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_objid_index" btree (objid)
    "dleobjectderef_data_table_and_name_idx" btree (cpmitable, name) WHERE cpmitable IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_tsdata_gin_idx" gin (tsdata, domainid) WHERE tsdata IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_tsfacet_gin_idx" gin (tsfacet) WHERE tsfacet IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_data_validname_index" btree (validname) WHERE validname = false
    "dleobjectderef_data_varfields_idx" gin (varfields jsonb_path_ops, domainid) WHERE varfields IS NOT NULL
    "dleobjectderef_editing_session_index" btree (editingsession) WHERE editingsession <> '-1'::integer
Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON dleobjectderef_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_dleobjectderef_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON dleobjectderef_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_dleobjectderef_data()

```

           Column            |          Type          | Collation | Nullable |              Default               | Storage  | Stats target | Description

Indexes:
    "linksmgrtestorphan_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)

    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON linksmgrtestorphan_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_linksmgrtestorphan_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON linksmgrtestorphan_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_linksmgrtestorphan_data()

Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON natrule_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_natrule_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON natrule_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_natrule_data()
